options.content:
BioETL Overview

Primary question: what is currently broken or degraded in BioETL, and where should the operator drill down first?

Scope: pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, selected Grafana time range. Owner: sre-data-platform. Audience: SRE, data engineer, product/project owner.

panels.title: Failed Pipeline Runs
panels.description: Red means at least one failed pipeline run in the selected range. Next action: open 2. Runtime.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="gold"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: Overall Yield
panels.description: Bronze to Gold selected-range yield. Red <0.8, yellow >=0.8, green >=0.9. Next action: open 4. Data Quality.

panels.title: Active Stage Backlog
panels.description: Worst active stage backlog in selected range. Non-zero means open 2. Runtime.

panels.title: Worst Stage Lag
panels.description: Worst stage lag in selected range. Yellow starts at 300 seconds. Next action: open 2. Runtime.

panels.title: DQ Blocking
panels.description: Hard-fail DQ validation events in selected range. Next action: open 4. Data Quality.

targets.expr: (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Control Plane Unsafe
panels.description: Manifest, ledger, checkpoint, or lineage unsafe events. Next action: open Control Plane v1.

targets.expr: round((sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_degraded_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_failures_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_data_source_retry_exhausted_total[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Provider Degraded
panels.description: Provider degraded/failure health checks or exhausted retries in selected range. Next action: open 3. Provider Health.

dataLinks.title: Open Logs in Loki Explore (tracing profile)
Open Traces in Tempo Explore (tracing profile)

panels.title: Processing Volume by Stage
panels.description: Throughput trend only; use DQ/Runtime for detailed diagnosis.

panels.title: Pipeline Run Outcomes
panels.description: Run status trend by selected interval.

panels.title: Stage Backlog Trend
panels.description: Gauge trend for unresolved stage backlog.

panels.title: Stage Lag Trend
panels.description: Gauge trend for unresolved stage lag.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(bioetl_pipeline_runs_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + ((max(max_over_time(bioetl_stage_backlog_records{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((max(max_over_time(bioetl_stage_lag_seconds{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) >= bool 300)

panels.title: Runtime Handoff
panels.description: Open Runtime for failed runs, backlog, lag, runtime errors.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(bioetl_dq_validation_failures_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", severity="hard_fail"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + round(sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Data Quality Handoff
panels.description: Open Data Quality for yield loss, hard DQ failures, Silver rejects.

targets.expr: (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Control Plane Handoff
panels.description: Open Control Plane v1 for manifest, ledger, checkpoint, lineage, replay, and audit detail.

targets.expr: round((sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_degraded_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_failures_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_data_source_retry_exhausted_total[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Provider Handoff
panels.description: Open Provider Health for provider degradation, health checks, retry exhaustion, and adapter latency.

panels.title: Workflow Handoff
panels.description: Open Workflow Overview for declarative workflow failures or status distribution.

targets.expr: (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (round(sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Manifest / Ledger Failures
panels.description: Compact selected-range control-plane write failure summary.

panels.title: Checkpoint Incompatibilities
panels.description: Resume/checkpoint compatibility blocks in selected range.

panels.title: Lineage Refs Missing
panels.description: Missing upstream lineage references in selected range.

panels.title: Silver Filter Rejects
panels.description: Intentional Silver exclusions in selected range. Open Data Quality for bounded cause breakdown.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

panels.title: Silver Filter Reject Rate
panels.description: Silver reject share of Bronze input in selected range.

options.content: Next dashboard: 2. Runtime for failed runs/backlog/lag; 4. Data Quality for yield/DQ/Silver rejects; 3. Provider Health for provider degradation; Control Plane v1 for manifest/ledger/checkpoint/lineage; 6. Workflow Overview for declarative workflow failures; Loki Explore and Tempo Explore for tracing-profile correlation.
